eventsManage.manageSubtitle: Create, submit, and manage events your organization hosts.
eventsManage.newEventSubtitle: Fill in the event details, then submit for university review.
eventsManage.noEventsBody: Create your first event to start taking registrations.
eventsManage.noEventsFilterBody: There are no events with this status right now.
eventsManage.conflictBody: This event was just changed elsewhere. We've refreshed the data.
eventsManage.notEditableToast: Only draft or rejected events can be edited.
eventsManage.illegalTransitionToast: That action isn't available in the current state.
eventsManage.editSubtitle: Update the details before submitting for review.
eventsManage.ownerNotFoundBody: This event doesn't exist or doesn't belong to your organization.
eventsManage.permissionBody: You don't have permission to manage this organization's events.
eventsManage.rejectionHint: Update the event based on the feedback, then resubmit.
eventsManage.pendingReviewHint: This event is awaiting university review. You can't edit it until there's a decision.
eventsManage.cancelledHint: This event has been cancelled. Registrants have been notified.
eventsManage.submitConfirmBody: The event will be sent to the university for review.
eventsManage.submitConfirmNote: After submitting, you can't edit it until it's approved or rejected.
eventsManage.cancelConfirmBody: All registrants and waitlisted users will be notified.
eventsManage.deleteConfirmBody: The event will be archived and no longer shown.

form.title: Event title
form.coverHelp: Paste a public image link (http/https). Leave blank if none.
form.onlineNote: Online events don't need a venue. The access link is managed separately and shared with registrants close to start time.
form.registrationOpensHelp: Leave blank to open registration as soon as it's published.
form.registrationClosesHelp: Leave blank to close when the event starts.
form.visibilityHelp: Controls who can see this event.

validation.titleMin: Title must be at least 3 characters.
validation.descriptionMin: Description must be at least 10 characters.
validation.url: Enter a valid link (http or https).
validation.endsAfterStart: End time must be after the start time.
validation.closeBeforeStart: Registration must close at or before the event start.

attendees.title: Registrant list
attendees.emptyBody: Registrants will appear here once the event is published.
attendees.permissionBody: Only the organizer and university staff can view this list.
attendees.privacyNote: Email is shown to the organizer for event communication only. Please don't share it.
attendees.insightCheckInPending: Confirmed attendees are ready — check them in on the day of the event
attendees.insightHighAttendance: High attendance rate — great turnout for this event
attendees.insightWaitlistPresent: Waitlisted registrants are available — consider increasing capacity if possible
attendees.insightLowCheckin: Check-in rate is low — follow up with confirmed attendees
attendees.insightEventComplete: All confirmed attendees have been checked in — event complete

eventsManage.insightPendingEvents: Some events are awaiting moderation approval — they cannot be promoted yet
eventsManage.insightFillingUp: One or more events are nearly full — consider opening a waitlist or adding capacity
eventsManage.insightPublishedActive: Your published events are live — share them to boost registrations
eventsManage.insightNoRegistrations: A published event has no registrations yet — promote it to reach more attendees
eventsManage.insightAlmostFull: Event is {pct}% full — strong registrations! Confirm logistics and prepare for capacity.
eventsManage.insightRegistrations: {count} {count, plural, =1 {registration} other {registrations}} so far — keep promoting to reach capacity
eventsManage.insightEventSoon: Event starts in {days} {days, plural, =1 {day} other {days}} — prepare communications and review the attendee list
eventsManage.insightEventUpcoming: Event is {days} days away — registrations are still open
